transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Thank you for joining this equipment-readiness check. As you know, we have one mobile bariatric lift available for immediate assignment, and both the North and South inpatient units have patients whose transfer plans are being reviewed for use of the lift. Before I can finalize the assignment and approve the associated operational plan, hospital policy requires us to hold this brief readiness check with physical therapy, facilities, nursing education, and infection prevention. I'd like to go around and hear from each of you on the readiness of the lift and any concerns related to your area. Let's start with physical therapy — can you walk us through the lift's current status and any clinical considerations?
